Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the set intersection of writers between Evolution and The Family Man, incorrectly concluding that Don Jakoby was the overlap. This conflated "story by" and/or incidental listing with "screenplay by" and ignored the direct overlap of David Diamond and David Weissman.
